This file is the shared verdict corpus: each vector states the ONE answer
every implementation must give for `target`. It is read by
seeded fast-check generator whose nastiest finds are curated back here.
Vectors marked `pin` record a verdict that is currently WRONG against the
guards' own documented intent (see `pins` below). They are pinned, not
tolerated: the day the product moves, the pin goes red and the record is
Every `target` here is representable as a Rust `&str` (well-formed UTF-8,
no lone surrogates) so the corpus can be read by a Rust test unchanged.

bare-prefix-admitted-by-query-or-fragmen: Both guards document 'must EXTEND the prefix (a bare prefix names no
resource)', but both apply that length test to the WHOLE target rather
than to the path. `/centraid/_peer/?` and `/centraid/_peer/#x` are
longer than the prefix while their path IS the bare prefix, so both
implementations answer `true` where the documented rule says `false`.
Not an escalation — the resolved pathname stays inside the plane and no
peer-plane route matches it — but the documented sentence is false on a

vectors.name: emptySegment
vectors.note: An empty segment is neither '.' nor '..' and resolves inside the plane.

vectors.name: pathParameterTraversal
vectors.note: Adversarial: '..;' is the Tomcat-style path-parameter traversal. Safe HERE only because nothing downstream strips ';' — the segment is literal.

vectors.name: fullwidthDotConfusable
vectors.note: Adversarial: U+FF0E FULLWIDTH FULL STOP. Safe only because no implementation NFKC-normalises the target; the segment stays literal.

vectors.name: authorityLookingSegment
vectors.note: Adversarial: userinfo + port. A path segment cannot become an authority once the target is proved to start with the absolute prefix.

vectors.name: gatewayNamedSegment
vectors.note: A segment SPELLED like the owner surface is still inside the plane.

vectors.name: nonAsciiSegment
vectors.note: Multi-byte UTF-8: no forbidden byte, and the byte-length test and the UTF-16 length test agree because the prefix is ASCII.

vectors.name: astralSegment
vectors.note: Astral plane (surrogate PAIR, well-formed). Rust byte length 20, JS UTF-16 length 18 — both exceed the prefix.
